pythonFunction.name: check_active_service_at_address
pythonFunction.description:
Checks whether gas service is already active at an address, which decides between a new start
and a transfer. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it
runs.

Args:
    address: The standardized service address (REQUIRED).

Returns:
    dict with ok, found, active_service and occupied. The result is recorded for the session;
    create_service_order refuses a plain start at an address that is active and occupied (offer a transfer).
